name: codex-council
description: Design complex features from scratch with adaptive interviews, bounded specialist review and verified implementation.

interface.longDescription: Mind guides adaptive architecture interviews. Forge turns settled decisions into a proposal, Council challenges it at simple, mid or ultra effort, and Hyper builds the authorized scope with executed checks. Local briefs, estimates, role tuning and optional shadow replay keep decisions traceable.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Mind to turn this idea into an implementation proposal, review it, and—after a blocker-free build verdict and confirmation of my authorization for the unchanged scope—have Hyper apply the approved scope, run the required checks, and report PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN.
Use Codex Council to review this change for blockers and verification.
Project this completed session into the experimental Decision Runtime.
